items.title: Morgan Park Man Murdered His Mom After Throwing Her Belongings Into Front Yard: Prosecutors
items.description: Joseph Ruiz has been charged with fatally assaulting his 84-year-old mother days after they were seen in an altercation outside their home, prosecutors said.

items.title: With New Democratic Congress Incoming, Pritzker Calls For Federal AI Regulations
items.description: This proposal would build on existing statewide AI regulations that differ from the federal government’s current hands-off approach of non-binding agreements.

items.title: Mayor Says He’s ‘Always’ Favored Gunshot Detection Technology As Voters Back Its Return
items.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson, who got rid of ShotSpotter, says he supports a system that "protects privacy and demonstrates effectiveness."

items.title: Thattu, Popular Southwest Indian Restaurant, Closing In Avondale After 3 Years
items.description: While the restaurant was busy when it first opened, business has struggled more recently. Business owners plan to bring back pop-ups and travel with their cuisine.

items.title: Where To Get Your Thanksgiving Pie In Chicago
items.description: The time to pre-order is now. Here are 31 bakeries offering traditional and unique pies and pastries for the holiday.

items.title: Chatham Is A ‘Veterinary Care Desert.’ A New Pet Clinic Is Opening To Fill That Void
items.description: Dr. Simuel Hampton, a Chatham resident, will welcome his first patients on Tuesday to Chatham Veterinary Clinic, the neighborhood’s only animal care clinic.

items.title: 2 Business Owners Challenge Ald. Daniel La Spata In 1st Ward Race
items.description: La Spata seeks his third term and faces Laura Yepez, the 1st Ward committeeperson for the Cook County Democratic Party, and businessman Bill Thanoukos.

items.title: 3 Uptown Residents Challenging Ald. Angela Clay In 46th Ward Race
items.description: One of those residents, Nicole A. Edelman, is also challenging Clay’s petition signatures, threatening the incumbent's ability to appear on the February ballot.
